applies_why: The judge text determines that Luke 2:48-49 is answered for D4 vs C2, which is the counting decision K-G4 governs.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge states the verse was answered, so under the rule it is not counted as an unanswered witness; no required quote of a pressing sentence applies because it is not being counted.
